verdict.rationale: Gusto's docs say employees must configure federal and state tax information (W-4-type data) as part of their onboarding, and that pre-built UI Flows exist. The evidence does not show a self-serve link sent to a new hire, I-9 collection, or employee bank-account capture before day one. missing for 10: documented self-serve new-hire invite/onboarding flow, I-9 collection, employee direct-deposit/bank detail collection, pre-start-date completion, independent or hands-on corroboration

support.subject: As an ops user, I can send a new hire a self-serve onboarding flow that collects W-4, I-9, and bank details before day one

citations.quote: Employees are required to configure two types of tax information as part of their onboarding: Federal tax... State tax:
An employee must provide federal tax information to file and pay taxes correctly.
